input_boundary: Generator runs before the diagnostic reads SQLite. Expectations come from generated observations and public model state, never actual response or database fields.
stored_evidence_access: The diagnostic decrypts sender/receiver transport evidence. It does not read private computation tables or feed stored evidence to generation.
failure_controls: Privileged synthetic storage mutations; not claims of spontaneous runtime faults or feasible external attacks.
assumptions_and_limits: Compose with R1-R4; selected projections are not every stored field or a universal inductive relation.
Static public setup, at most two successful operations, no key/credential/route management beyond existing root controls.
One context per recipient in this fixture; no retirement or cleanup, including no hidden deletion of first facts.
Deferred confirmation names the latest generated receipt; arbitrary older ACK selection and late-packet interleavings remain open.
Completed event boundaries only; no crash/recovery, physical timing, disk/witness traffic or resource exhaustion modeling.
Shared codecs, signatures and prefix algorithms; no independent cryptographic implementation or complete DP proof.
